Looks like it depends on the activity of other posts in the sub it's in. Based on what I've seen browsing around for a couple hours, the rate at which a post must be upvoatd to hit front page depends on what sub it's in. If a sub doesn't usually get much activity and then a new post gets several upvoats, it can make to to front, or at least rank high on /v/all. If a post only gets 50 voats in a sub where the average post gets 60 voats, it stands no chance.
